title: Numbered Doors
physical_identity: Four hallways each ~26 miles long meeting at a small open square with chairs and a desk; doors repeat along both sides and lead to labelled destinations.
scale_topology: Large; four radial hallways from a central square; shifting hallways; separate non-shifting infinite Exit-door halls.
anomalies: Doors mostly lead back to Level 21 or onto a wall
Neon red Exit door to three dark non-shifting infinite hallways
lighting_sound: not stated (Exit door has neon red sign; Exit halls are dark)
entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Clickers, unknown entities; none in central square

entrances.quote: Various tears in the walls of Level 13 can be entered to reach this level.
encountered occasionally on Level 11 , Level 9 , and Level 6
entered from Level 1.5 by random chance from noclipping

exits.quote: Doors composed of sandstone can lead to Level 46 .
Doors labelled with a smiley face lead to a party! =)
Doors labelled 8-20 lead to their respective Levels.

exits.to: Random places, negative levels, sub-sections, Level 21, wall
exits.quote: Other doors can lead to random things and are not to be trusted.

exits.method: Neon red Exit door right of the front desk
exits.quote: The door, when opened, leads to three dark hallways.
only lead to Sub-sections and Unnumbered Levels

signature_mechanic: Four long shifting hallways of repeating doors where labels determine destination; most doors loop back or hit a wall; a safe central square.
conflicts_notes: Page flagged outdated. Intro says 'four long hallways'; Exit door leads to three more. Levels 20 and 22 appear only as link targets. Level 356 has no slug in link list.

key_quotes.quote: The centre of the Level is a small open square with chairs and a desk.
Entities never appear in this area but, instead, appear in the hallways.
More often than not, they will cause you to appear somewhere else in Level 21 or put you on a wall.
no known bases, outposts, or communities
